notes: National rules; local income tax is filed with the city, county or district of the head office.

items.name: Corporate Income Tax Return
items.rule: Within 3 months after financial year end
items.description: Filed through Hometax with the financial statements and tax adjustment schedules.

items.name: Local Corporate Income Tax Return
items.rule: Within 4 months after financial year end
items.description: Filed separately with the city, county or district through Wetax.
items.authority: City, county or district tax office

items.name: Interim Corporate Income Tax
items.rule: Within 2 months after the first 6 months of the financial year
items.applies: Companies and branches (small companies with little prior-year tax are exempt)
items.description: Half of last year's tax, or tax on the first six months' results.

items.name: Ordinary General Meeting — Approval of Financial Statements
items.rule: Within 3 months after financial year end
items.description: The members or shareholders approve the financial statements.

items.name: Court Registry Changes (directors, address, capital)
items.rule: Within 2 weeks of the change (directors of a Jusik Hoesa serve up to 3 years)
items.description: Late registration brings a court fine on the representative director.

items.name: External Auditor Appointment
items.rule: Within 45 days of the start of the financial year
items.applies: Companies above the External Audit Act size thresholds
items.description: The appointment is reported to the Securities and Futures Commission.

items.name: VAT Returns (quarterly)
items.description: Preliminary returns in April and October and final returns in July and January.

items.name: VAT Returns (half-yearly)
items.rule: 25 July and 25 January (with preliminary payments notified in April and October)
items.applies: Sole proprietors who are general taxpayers
items.description: Simplified taxpayers file once a year, by 25 January.

items.name: Global Income Tax Return and Local Income Tax
items.description: Business income for the previous calendar year; interim tax is notified in November.

items.name: Interim Income Tax Prepayment
items.applies: Sole proprietors notified of an interim prepayment
items.description: Half of the previous year's income tax, notified by the tax office.

items.name: Withholding Tax Return and Payment
items.rule: 10th of the following month (half-yearly for approved employers with 20 or fewer staff)
items.description: Income tax and local income tax withheld from wages.

items.name: Year-End Tax Settlement and Payment Statements
items.description: Employees' tax for the previous year is settled in the February payroll and wage payment statements are filed.

items.name: Four Social Insurances (pension, health, employment, industrial accident)
items.description: Billed together by the National Health Insurance Service.
items.authority: National Health Insurance Service / National Pension Service

items.name: Foreign Investment Notification and Registration
items.rule: Notify before the investment; register as a foreign-invested company within 60 days of paying in the capital
items.description: Filed through a foreign exchange bank or KOTRA under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act.
items.authority: KOTRA / Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy

items.name: Statement of International Transactions
items.rule: Within 6 months after financial year end
items.applies: Companies and branches with transactions with foreign related parties
items.description: Filed with details of the transfer pricing method used.

items.name: Transfer Pricing Master File and Local File
items.rule: Within 12 months after financial year end
items.applies: Companies with revenue over KRW 100 billion and cross-border related-party transactions over KRW 50 billion
items.description: Smaller companies provide documentation within 60 days of a request.
